findings.evidence: The proof uses `P` and `hx` only at lines 153–158 to obtain convergence of `xⁿ * t` and an open neighborhood on which `v < 1`; the rest is valuation-level. The nearby `Valuation.IsContinuous.cofinalValue_of_isTopologicallyNilpotent` in `Continuous/TopologicallyNilpotent.lean:117` is already stated at that natural general level.
findings.fix: First prove a valuation-level theorem from `HasFullCharacteristicGroup v`, `IsTopologicallyNilpotent x`, and openness (or neighborhood membership) of `{a | v a < 1}`, then derive this Huber statement using `P.isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_mem_idealOfDefinition hx`, `P.isOpen_idealImage 1`, and `h1`.
findings.issue: `cofinalValue_of_hasFullCharacteristicGroup` unnecessarily specializes the underlying topological argument to `PairOfDefinition` and ideal membership.

summary: The result is stated only for a pair of definition although its argument naturally applies to any topologically nilpotent element with an open unit ball.
